items.text: Puka Nacua listed QUESTIONABLE (calf); will test pregame per McVay. Status crucial for DFS slate.
items.why: Calf issue limited power/explosion; majority practice Thursday but pregame test.
items.implication: If OUT, hierarchy Tyler Higbee primary then Mumpfield/Parkinson/Atwell.
items.opportunity: If active full routes/targets; if out TE/WR2+ volume spike

items.text: Lamar Jackson QUESTIONABLE (ankle/high ankle sprain); could be GTD. Crucial for slate.
items.why: Returned practice, heading right direction but limp noted earlier; coach GTD possible.
items.implication: If OUT Huntley starts; if IN full dual-threat upside vs CIN.

items.text: Breece Hall QUESTIONABLE (quad); status key for main slate.
items.implication: If active start vs MIA per Berry; if OUT Allen full work.

items.text: Brian Robinson OUT (hamstring); sneaky important scratch. Bijan full opportunity vs SF DvP.
items.why: Hamstring; Falcons elevate Herbert. SF DvP inflates opp RB +4.4%.
items.implication: Bijan larger workload/carries vs soft SF run D recently allowing RB catches/TDs.
items.opportunity: Bijan near-full snaps/carries/goal-line; no BRob split

items.text: Mike Evans and Deebo Samuel ruled OUT for 49ers vs Falcons.
items.why: Evans Achilles; Deebo hamstring. Coach confirmed Evans OUT.
items.implication: 49ers WR corps decimated; CMC/Kittle funnel + possible CMC slot.
items.opportunity: Remaining skill players higher target/route share

items.text: Emeka Egbuka, Tyler Warren, David Montgomery OUT. Sneaky scratches.
items.why: Egbuka concussion/foot; Warren sidelined; Mont DNP sessions. Schefter confirms.
items.implication: TB WR/TE shifts; IND TE to others; HOU RB to backups.

items.text: Davante Adams and Jeremiyah Love OUT.
items.why: Adams hamstring long-term; Love scratched. Confirmed multi-sources.
items.implication: LAR more 12/13 personnel TEs if Puka also limited; ARI RB hierarchy.

items.text: Josh Jacobs and Quinshon Judkins IN/expected. Addison/Hockenson also IN.
items.why: Cleared; Jacobs facility access earlier, backups poor EPA.
items.implication: Jacobs lead back despite Berry hate on layoff; Judkins RB work.

items.text: Tempted by CMC lining up more slot amid 49ers dire WR injuries (Evans/Deebo OUT); rarely buys RB-as-WR but scheme/Kaelon Black fit.
items.why: CMC smiled at question; WR corps hurt creates funnel.
items.implication: Elevated routes/targets/PPR upside beyond standard RB.

items.text: Rashee Rice and Zach Charbonnet ruled OUT (Rice hamstring pictured; Charbonnet SEA vs KC).
items.implication: KC WR hierarchy shifts (Worthy etc); SEA RB to Walker full if Charbonnet out.

items.text: Loves Saquon Barkley return; if active vs DAL start him (efficient prior, great matchup). Rank ~RB15.
items.why: Back at practice; Stephania agrees start if out there vs Cowboys MNF.
items.implication: Immediate lineup lock if active; volume return.
items.opportunity: Lead RB snaps/carries/targets vs soft DAL

items.text: Bijan full opportunity vs SF DvP with BRob OUT; SF inflating opp RB by 4.4% (7th most), recent RB receptions/TDs allowed.
items.why: BRob hamstring OUT; DvP data + recent examples (White/Holani/Harvey/Love).

items.text: Luther Burden 68.8% routes but elite 2.56 YPRR; Kmet IR season-ending gives more juice (less 2/3 sets). Henderson only 21% snaps L3 weeks.
items.why: Kmet serious knee to IR; Burden efficiency + route rate bump potential. Henderson snap share low.
items.implication: Burden WR upside boost; fade/monitor Henderson role.

items.text: Loves Jaylen Warren (@NO RB9), Chuba Hubbard (vs TB RB10), Bucky Irving (@CAR RB12) for workloads + friendly matchups.
items.why: Big workloads; defenses carved by RBs; Hubbard consistency.
